leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Kanban board layout with multiple columns using HTML and CSS
Initialize card data as JavaScript objects with properties like title, description, and status
Implement a function to render cards dynamically into their corresponding columns
Apply event listeners to cards to enable drag-and-drop interactions
Manipulate card status when moving between columns during drag operations
Update the visual state of columns to provide drop zone feedback
Integrate drag-and-drop functionality to control card movement across the entire board
